title: WHIRLWIND PROPHECY - THE TRANSLATION!

blocks.text: “As we have noticed remarkable and important events in prophecy are taking place across the whole earth! The world is going through vast changes in many different ways just as the Scripts predicted years ago! We are in the twilight of time! Nature and the weather alone is a sign showing us Jesus is coming very soon! More on this in a moment!”

Let’s check the Scriptures concerning the rapture (translation)! – I Cor. 15:52, “In a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trump: for the trumpet shall sound, and the dead shall be raised incorruptible, and we shall be changed!” – I Thess. 4:16-17, “For the Lord Himself shall descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel, and with the trump of God: and the dead in Christ shall rise first: Then we which are alive and remain shall be caught up together with them in the clouds, to meet the Lord in the air: and so shall we ever be with the Lord!” – “Paul tells us in these words the Translation of the church! A type of Jesus rapturing His saints is described in the Old Testament story of Elijah! . . . As the prophet crossed Jordan a wonderful event took place suddenly. There appeared a chariot of fire and parted them asunder, and Elijah went up by a whirlwind to heaven!” (II Kings 2:11)

“This amazing event was foretelling of the Translation of the saints!” – “Notice in the preceding verses that the angels in this fantastic celestial ship were able to defy gravity and part the waters of Jordan, so that Elijah walked through in another dimension into this celestial wonder and by supernatural power was caught away! . . . And one day soon we will defy gravity, and the heavens will be open, and we will be caught up in another dimension to meet Jesus!” . . . “Also the translation of Enoch bears witness to this same truth, when the Lord translated him without seeing death!” – “As you remember Enoch walked with God, but all of a sudden he was gone! Also even as in the case of Elijah as he was talking to Elisha, and the next minute he (Elijah) was gone!” – “So will it be in the case of the elect! Jesus is coming quickly and suddenly, in a moment, in a twinkling of an eye, the saints will be gone merging into the rays of eternity!” – “Some of the incredible lights that has been seen in the heavens is evidently a foreshadow of the coming of the Lord and the translation of His church! . . . And also is a warning of the destruction that shall come upon the earth!”

“As we were speaking before, one of the signs of Jesus’ coming is seen in the weather! We will see it occur just exactly as the Scripts predicted! We have seen heat waves striking different nations, terrible snowstorms and floods in other places, drought and famine affecting many nations, killer quakes, giant tornadoes and hurricanes destroying property and taking with them many lives!” – “All of these things are just warnings revealing greater events to come concerning these same subjects! . . . And according to prophecy we know that later in the future the headlines of the newspaper will read, ‘The Earth’s Worst Drought and Famine Is Occurring’ – They will say, world food shortage is near, as panic grips the hearts of the population! – So we are forecasting in a minor way, of what will take place in a major way unparalleled in history! It will seem like science fiction to some, but it will be a reality!” – “So we can know and we can forecast that it will be many times worse than what we have seen concerning not only these subjects, but many other events that we have forecast! . . . And the rest of it will not be quiet by no means for there is yet more to take place!”

“In the years ahead we will also see dramatic and incredible events affecting China, Russia, Japan, the Middle East, the office of the Pope and events affecting the presidency of the United States! – Plus the United States itself will be going through some vast changes affecting every department and life of its society! – Get ready, for you are going to see some amazing things take place in this nation! – We will write more concerning future events, but if you check your Scrolls you will see all that’s on them will take place at its appointed time! As prophecy marches on to its destination!”

“We might add during the events above that we spoke about concerning the weather and etc., a strange and mysterious man will rise. Up until this point he has been like a phantom and has not revealed his true identity yet! His character will be like the classic story, Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde, wherein he will have twin personalities! The first type of his personality will be dove-like, but deceptive and cunning and then later the second personality is from the pits of hell, savage beast-like! A fierce countenance will suddenly appear, a killer spirit begins to work! . . . But it is too late then, the people are caught in a trap! Multitudes will fall for his deceptions! But in so doing they will believe a lie!” – “The anti-Christ will have his insignia – a mark! He will use it as a loyalty test to accomplish his diabolic purposes! He will strike where it hurts the most! He will declare no one can buy or sell or receive food without this insignia! . . . And they will wear this mark unto their doom! Then the world will enter its most terrible persecution in its whole history!” . . . And the people will say, “Who is like unto the beast? Who is able to make war with him?” (Rev. 13:4) – “This figure is near and he will appear at the appointed time!”

“Considering all of these things, we must prepare, watch and pray and work in His harvest as never before! For we also know, that Jesus tells us to be alert and expecting!” – “Be ye also ready, for in such an hour as ye think not, the son of man cometh!” (St. Matt. 24:44)

“So let us praise the Lord together and rejoice, for we are living in a victorious and momentous time for the church! It is a time of faith and exploits! It is a time that we can have whatsoever we saith by using our faith! The hour of speak the word only and it shall be done! . . . And as the Scripture says, ‘All things are possible to them that believe!’ – This is our hour to shine for Jesus!”
